Base design components of the proposed 3D modeling system. (a) A ground base with a reference marker, indicating floor orientation and helping users sense weight distribution and body balance. Final design of the 3D tactile pose models used in the study. All figures in (a) and (b) are mounted on flat bases to enhance tactile stability and alignment.
